data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 边境小镇的白誓约
data.description: 旅途暂歇，她换上简洁的象牙白婚纱，浣熊耳朵紧张地竖起，双手捧着野花束走过彩窗下的长椅；尾巴小心收在裙后，听见钟声时终于露出可靠又羞涩的笑。
data.location: stone chapel beside a frontier town
data.action: 彩窗下捧野花束回眸，兽耳竖起，尾巴藏在裙后露出可靠的羞涩笑
data.lighting: warm afternoon rays through stained glass
data.promptProse: Raphtalia carries wildflowers toward the altar in both hands, ears above her short veil and tail tucked behind her skirt, smiling back shyly. Stained-glass afternoon light crosses the aisle and pews.
data.animaCaption: Her ears rise above the short veil and her tail stays tucked behind the skirt.
